what: add a role entry, with no grant wider than that agent already has by its own brief, for every account-6 agent session not yet listed, the SovereignWebsite and @dinis sessions on account 6 included (cl-6.security access review A8)
add a list of every website managed on account 6 and the agent that keeps each
add a conductors map: each conductor and the agents it runs
limits: account 6 only: no session or repository of another account

a shared repository keeps its own keeper's policy (for example Site__Agent__Decisions' site/policy/abp.json, kept by decisions.2); cl-6.abp's entry for an account-6 agent there may only be the same or narrower, never wider
no new grant, tool, repository, scheduled task or breaker exemption for anyone under this record; installing the hook kit in other repositories is P8, decided separately
